title: Quick Saffron Italian Rice Neapolitan Pizza
description: A low-carb friendly twist on a classic Italian dish, featuring a rice syrup and jocheong sauce on a crispy pinsa crust, wrapped in a ssam-style leaf.

ingredients.name: Rice syrup
ingredients.notes: or substitute with honey or maple syrup

ingredients.name: Jocheong sauce
ingredients.notes: Korean chili paste, can be adjusted to taste

instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°F (260°C) with a baking stone or a cast-iron skillet.
Roll out the cauliflower pinsa dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a piece of parchment paper or a lightly floured pizza peel.
Brush the crust with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Spread the rice syrup evenly over the crust, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the jocheong sauce over the rice syrup, making sure to cover the entire surface.
Sprinkle the fresh mozzarella over the sauce, followed by the saffron threads.
Transfer the pizza to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the pizza from the oven and top with fresh basil leaves and shaved parmesan cheese.
Wrap the pizza in a ssam leaf, leaving a small border around the edges.
